features.name: Age Eligibility on Sections
features.description: Restricting who can register for a section based on a minimum/maximum age.
features.signal: eligibility_rule.attribute_name (value 'age' or 'date_of_birth') with eligibility_rule.comparison_operator/attribute_value, linked to a section via eligibility_rule_group_lookup.section_id; section.age_evaluation_type governs how the age date is resolved
features.adoption_definition: Has >=1 section with an age-based eligibility rule attached (an eligibility_rule whose attribute is age/date_of_birth, joined through eligibility_rule_group_lookup.section_id)
features.measure_question: How many of this organization's sections have an age minimum or maximum eligibility requirement, and how many sections does it have in total?

features.name: Grade Eligibility on Sections
features.description: Restricting section registration to specific school grade levels.
features.signal: eligibility_rule.attribute_name = 'grade' (with attribute_value/comparison_operator), linked to a section via eligibility_rule_group_lookup.section_id
features.adoption_definition: Has >=1 live section with a grade-based eligibility rule, joined through eligibility_rule_group_lookup.section_id exactly as age rules are. Measured 2026-09-07: 37 of 73 launched orgs (44 of 144 including unlaunched), 1,567 in total.
features.measure_question: How many of this organization's sections have a grade-level eligibility requirement, and how many sections total?

features.name: Residency-Based Eligibility Zones
features.description: Auto-assigning residents to a group (for resident pricing/access) using ZIP-code or geographic-polygon zones.
features.signal: residency_zipcode_group (820 rows, 46 orgs) and residency_polygon_group (41,454 rows, 35 orgs); organization_residency_transfer.
features.adoption_definition: Has >=1 residency zone of either kind. An org may use zip lists or drawn polygons or both, so the count is the sum rather than one of them.
features.measure_question: How many residency zones (ZIP-code groups plus polygon groups) has this organization defined?

features.name: Enrollment Prerequisites
features.description: Requiring participants to meet a prior condition (segment membership) before they can enroll in a section.
features.signal: prereq (section_id, segment_id, segment_query, activated_at).
features.adoption_definition: Has >=1 prerequisite CONFIGURED. Deliberately not activated_at: 1,186 prereq rows exist across 24 orgs and ZERO are activated, so filtering on activation reads 0 for everyone and hides two dozen orgs that set them up.
features.measure_question: How many of this organization's sections have an enrollment prerequisite configured, and how many sections total?

features.name: Scheduled Registration Windows
features.description: Opening and closing registration for a section at specific scheduled times.
features.signal: registration_window (opens_at, closes_at, section_id, type). Type is 'default' (67,379) or 'group' (23,825).
features.adoption_definition: Has >=1 default-type registration window. NEAR-UNIVERSAL BY CONSTRUCTION — every section gets one, so this is a structural fact rather than a differentiator. Kept because it is a real catalog feature and the page can hide it.
features.measure_question: How many of this organization's sections have a scheduled registration window (open/close times), and how many sections total?

features.name: Member Early-Access Registration Windows
features.description: Giving a specific member group early or exclusive registration access via a group-scoped window.
features.signal: registration_window.type = 'group' with group_id set.
features.adoption_definition: Has >=1 group-typed registration window actually bound to a group — the member early-access mechanism. 23,825 windows platform-wide.
features.measure_question: How many registration windows are restricted to a specific member group, and how many registration windows are there in total?

features.name: Invite-Only / Restricted Registration
features.description: Setting sections to a registration mode other than open, such as invite-only or waitlist-only.
features.signal: NONE THAT WORKS. section.registration_mode carries only 'section' (58,232) and 'per-session' (4,479) — whether you register for a whole section or session by session, which is a different question. There is no invite-only or restricted column on section at all.
features.adoption_definition: NOT MEASURABLE. The catalog previously said registration_mode carries "values other than 'open', e.g. invite_only, waitlist". It does not, and there is no 'open' value either — so `registration_mode <> 'open'` would report ALL 62,711 sections as restricted, i.e. 100% adoption of a feature with no schema support. Left unmeasured until the product grows the field. The nearest real mechanisms are group early-access windows and eligibility rules, both measured separately.
features.measure_question: How many sections have a registration mode other than open (e.g. invite-only or waitlist-only), and how many sections total?
features.not_measurable: section.registration_mode is about section-vs-per-session registration, not restriction. No invite-only field exists.

features.name: Section Waitlists
features.description: Allowing participants to join a waitlist when a section is full.
features.signal: section.waitlist_config (JSONB, e.g. {"enabled": true, "maxSize": 20}); section.waitlist_override; table: waitlist (participant_user_id, section_id)
features.adoption_definition: Has >=1 section with waitlist_config enabled, or >=1 waitlist entry
features.measure_question: How many of this organization's sections have a waitlist enabled, and how many sections total?

features.name: Required Participant Info
features.description: Requiring certain profile attributes to be filled in before a participant can register.
features.signal: section.required_info_config (JSONB describing required profile attributes)
features.adoption_definition: Has >=1 live section carrying a required_info_config — the JSONB that demands date of birth, gender, grade or an emergency contact at registration. An opt-in: 2,713 of 62,711 sections. Measured 2026-09-07: 43 of 73 launched orgs (52 of 144 including unlaunched), 2,471 in total.
features.measure_question: How many sections have required participant info configured, and how many sections total?

features.name: Custom Booking Questions
features.description: Collecting custom per-registration answers (e.g. t-shirt size, dietary needs) via program-level booking questions.
features.signal: table: default_booking_question (program_id, data JSONB); table: booking_question_response
features.adoption_definition: Has >=1 default_booking_question configured, or >=1 booking_question_response collected
features.measure_question: How many of this organization's programs have custom booking questions configured, and how many programs total?

features.name: Custom Forms
features.description: Building dynamic custom forms attached to sections, sites, or products to collect structured responses.
features.signal: table: form (schema JSONB); table: form_lookup (section_id/site/product); table: form_submission
features.adoption_definition: Has >=1 live form (form.deleted_at IS NULL). Whether the form is attached to anything is measured separately by form_on_file_reuse. Measured 2026-09-07: 58 of 73 launched orgs (80 of 144 including unlaunched), 1,162 in total.
features.measure_question: How many custom forms has this organization created, and how many form submissions has it collected?

features.name: Waivers & Legal Contracts
features.description: Requiring participants to sign waivers or legal contracts (e.g. on booking).
features.signal: contract_version.type — the real values are facility-policy, registration-policy, liability-waiver, refund-policy, facility-rental-refund-policy, code-of-conduct and three more. NOT 'waiver' / 'terms_of_service'. contract_version.requirement has exactly one value platform-wide ('soft-ack') and cannot discriminate anything.
features.adoption_definition: Has >=1 contract version of any type. Filtering on type='waiver' matches nothing at all.
features.measure_question: How many waiver/contract versions has this organization set up?

features.name: Reusable Forms On File
features.description: Letting participants reuse a previously submitted form instead of re-filling it each time.
features.signal: form_lookup.use_form_on_file = true
features.adoption_definition: Has >=1 form lookup with use_form_on_file = true, i.e. a form answered once and reused rather than re-asked every registration. Measured 2026-09-07: 43 of 73 launched orgs (51 of 144 including unlaunched), 11,071 in total.
features.measure_question: How many of this organization's form attachments are set to reuse a form on file, and how many form attachments total?

features.name: Guest Participation
features.description: Allowing non-member guests to join program sessions, often at a separate guest price.
features.signal: program.allow_guests = true (with program.guest_price)
features.adoption_definition: Has >=1 live programme with allow_guests = true. Genuinely rare: 14 programmes across 8 orgs platform-wide. Measured 2026-09-07: 5 of 73 launched orgs (8 of 144 including unlaunched), 14 in total.
features.measure_question: How many of this organization's programs allow guest participants, and how many programs total?

features.name: Skill-Level Tagging
features.description: Assigning a recommended/required skill level to programs or sections.
features.signal: section.skill_level and program.recommended_level, both enums of all | beginners | intermediate | advanced | first-timers.
features.adoption_definition: Has >=1 live section whose skill_level is set AND is not 'all'. 'all' MEANS NO RESTRICTION and is the commonest value (29,257 sections), so `skill_level IS NOT NULL` reports 54,785 sections as using skill levels when more than half are explicitly unrestricted. Measured: 25,528 real restrictions.
features.measure_question: How many sections have a skill level set, and how many sections total?

features.name: Add-On Products
features.description: Offering optional or required add-on products alongside a section, site, or activity.
features.signal: table: addon (product_id, is_required, min_quantity, max_quantity, pricing_strategy)
features.adoption_definition: Has >=1 add-on product (addon), the optional extras attached to a registration or rental. Measured 2026-09-07: 34 of 73 launched orgs (46 of 144 including unlaunched), 2,029 in total.
features.measure_question: How many add-on products has this organization configured, and how many of those are required add-ons?

features.name: Seasons
features.description: Grouping sections into named time periods (e.g. Spring 2025) with templated defaults.
features.signal: table: season (name, start_date, end_date, section_template JSONB); table: section_season
features.adoption_definition: Has >=1 live season. Note a season's declared start/end dates are its registration window and do NOT contain its sections' actual dates — that is recorded in the sibling reporting project and is why no date maths is done here. Measured 2026-09-07: 66 of 73 launched orgs (94 of 144 including unlaunched), 511 in total.
features.measure_question: How many seasons has this organization created, and how many sections are assigned to a season?

features.name: Instructor Profiles & Private Lessons
features.description: Maintaining instructor profiles, including instructors who offer private lessons.
features.signal: table: instructor (user_id, can_teach_private_lessons, is_pro, is_contractor); table: instructor_reservation_request
features.adoption_definition: Has >=1 instructor record. instructor.id is NOT users.id — the path is section_facilitator -> instructor -> users via instructor.user_id, and the obvious join matches nothing. Measured 2026-09-07: 51 of 73 launched orgs (64 of 144 including unlaunched), 1,064 in total.
features.measure_question: How many instructor profiles has this organization set up, and how many of them offer private lessons?

features.name: Instructor Certifications
features.description: Tracking instructor credentials and their expiration for compliance.
features.signal: table: instructor_certification (name, expires_at, instructor_id)
features.adoption_definition: Has >=1 tracked instructor certification with a name and expiry. The thinnest of the programme features: 15 orgs. Measured 2026-09-07: 11 of 73 launched orgs (15 of 144 including unlaunched), 70 in total.
features.measure_question: How many instructor certifications are recorded, and how many instructors does the organization have?

features.name: Memberships
features.description: Selling recurring or term memberships that grant access and pricing benefits.
features.signal: group_schema.type = 'membership' (1,009 plans platform-wide); membership, membership_user carry the members.
features.adoption_definition: Has >=1 membership PLAN configured. The count of live memberships is already a core usage metric, so this measures whether the org has set the feature up.
features.measure_question: How many memberships has this organization issued, and how many are currently active (status = 'active')?

features.name: Auto-Renewing Memberships
features.description: Memberships that automatically renew via recurring Stripe billing.
features.signal: group_schema.auto_renewal = true; membership.stripe_subscription_id; membership.next_renewal_at
features.adoption_definition: Has >=1 membership with a stripe_subscription_id or next_renewal_at set, or a group_schema with auto_renewal = true
features.measure_question: How many of this organization's memberships are set to auto-renew (have a Stripe subscription), and how many memberships total?

features.name: Passes / Punch Passes
features.description: Selling multi-use passes (e.g. 10-visit punch cards) with defined coverage and expiry.
features.signal: table: pass_schema (start_mechanism, end_mechanism, config e.g. totalUses); table: pass; table: pass_user
features.adoption_definition: Has >=1 pass TYPE configured (pass_schema). Active passes held by members are already a core usage metric. Note pass_schema has no subscription column at all, so a pass cannot auto-renew as a matter of schema. Measured 2026-09-07: 32 of 73 launched orgs (48 of 144 including unlaunched), 376 in total.
features.measure_question: How many pass types (pass schemas) has this organization set up, and how many passes have been issued?

features.name: Group/Pass Benefit Rules
features.description: Defining the access or pricing-discount benefits that a membership group or pass grants.
features.signal: table: benefit_rule (type, access_config JSONB, pricing_config JSONB, group_id, pass_schema_id); table: benefit_usage
features.adoption_definition: Has >=1 benefit rule — the access or pricing entitlement a membership or pass confers. Every rule on the platform is type 'access'; no pricing benefit rules exist yet. Measured 2026-09-07: 38 of 73 launched orgs (53 of 144 including unlaunched), 710 in total.
features.measure_question: How many benefit rules has this organization configured, and how many of them are pricing-discount benefits (type = 'pricing_discount')?

features.name: Physical Access Control Devices
features.description: Using door scanners/readers to grant physical entry via membership or pass.
features.signal: table: physical_access_device (seam_device_id); table: physical_access_device_scan_event (access, membership_id, pass_id)
features.adoption_definition: Has >=1 Seam-linked physical access device (a door or gate that reads a membership). The least adopted feature measured: 2 orgs, 3 devices. Measured 2026-09-07: 1 of 73 launched orgs (2 of 144 including unlaunched), 3 in total.
features.measure_question: How many physical access control devices (door scanners) has this organization registered?

features.name: Facility Rentals
features.description: Renting out facilities/spaces to customers via rental agreements.
features.signal: facility_rental (status: confirmed 515,503 / canceled 142,316 / in-progress 38,529; booking_type: instant 652,850 / managed 43,498).
features.adoption_definition: Has >=1 non-canceled facility rental. Canceled rentals are excluded — 142,316 of 696,348 rows. Measured 2026-09-07: 72 of 73 launched orgs, 545,922 non-canceled rentals in total.
features.measure_question: How many facility rentals has this organization created, and how many locations does it have?

features.name: Rental Applications
features.description: Requiring an application (with approval flow) before a facility can be rented at a site.
features.signal: site_rental_application_configuration.rental_application_enabled = true; table: rental_application
features.adoption_definition: Has >=1 site with rental_application_enabled = true, or >=1 rental_application
features.measure_question: How many sites have rental applications enabled, and how many sites (courts) does the organization have in total?

features.name: Instant Booking
features.description: Letting customers instantly confirm court/site reservations without admin approval.
features.signal: court.is_instant_bookable = true; table: site_instant_booking_configuration
features.adoption_definition: Has >=1 court with is_instant_bookable = true, or >=1 site_instant_booking_configuration
features.measure_question: How many of this organization's sites/courts are instant-bookable, and how many sites total?

features.name: Reservation Buffer Times
features.description: Enforcing a gap between back-to-back reservations on a court, or at a location.
features.signal: court.buffer_minutes_between_reservations > 0; court.reservation_buffer_minutes_override; location.reservation_buffer
features.adoption_definition: Has >=1 court with a nonzero buffer_minutes_between_reservations (or override), or a location with reservation_buffer set
features.measure_question: How many courts have a buffer time between reservations set (greater than zero), and how many courts total?

features.name: Security Deposits
features.description: Collecting refundable security/damage deposits on facility rentals.
features.signal: table: deposit (amount_cents, deposit_type, amount_retained_cents, amount_returned_cents)
features.adoption_definition: Has >=1 deposit taken. Types are 'security' (13,352) and 'key' (673); both count, because both are the deposit feature in use. Measured 2026-09-07: 44 of 73 launched orgs (59 of 144 including unlaunched), 13,758 in total.
features.measure_question: How many security deposits has this organization collected, and how many facility rentals does it have?

features.name: Facility Rental Permits
features.description: Issuing official permits for facility rentals.
features.signal: facility_rental_permit (status: issued 3,819 / draft 123 / revoked 14).
features.adoption_definition: Has >=1 ISSUED permit. A draft or revoked permit has no working public page, so it is not the feature in use.
features.measure_question: How many facility rental permits has this organization issued, and how many facility rentals does it have?

features.name: Member Reservation-Window Overrides
features.description: Giving specific member groups different court booking windows or duration limits.
features.signal: table: site_reservation_window (group_id, max_hours, min_hours, release_time_local)
features.adoption_definition: Has >=1 site reservation window bound to a group — the member-only booking horizon, with its own min/max hours and release time. Measured 2026-09-07: 71 of 73 launched orgs (116 of 144 including unlaunched), 6,094 in total.
features.measure_question: How many group-specific reservation-window overrides has this organization set up, and how many sites (courts) does it have?

features.name: Discount / Promo Codes
features.description: Offering promo codes with usage limits and validity windows.
features.signal: table: discount_code (code, pricing_adjustment JSONB, is_active, max_total_redemptions); table: discount_redemption
features.adoption_definition: Has >=1 discount code, of any kind and whether or not it has ever been redeemed — creating one is the adoption signal. Measured 2026-09-07: 32 of 73 launched orgs (37 of 144 including unlaunched), 137 in total.
features.measure_question: How many discount/promo codes has this organization created, and how many redemptions have been recorded?

features.name: Payment Plans / Installments
features.description: Letting customers pay for a registration in scheduled installments.
features.signal: section.available_payment_plans (JSONB PaymentPlanSpec[]); table: payment_plan_installment; order.flow = 'installment'
features.adoption_definition: Has >=1 section with available_payment_plans set, or >=1 payment_plan_installment
features.measure_question: How many of this organization's sections offer a payment plan (installments), and how many sections total?

features.name: Gift Cards
features.description: Selling gift cards that create stored-value accounts for later redemption.
features.signal: table: gift_card_product (value_cents, expiration_policy); stored_value_account.gift_card_product_id
features.adoption_definition: Has >=1 gift card PRODUCT configured (gift_card_product). Cards sold are a different number and are not measured here. Measured 2026-09-07: 8 of 73 launched orgs (11 of 144 including unlaunched), 42 in total.
features.measure_question: How many gift card products has this organization configured, and how many gift card accounts have been issued?

features.name: Scholarships / Financial Aid
features.description: Granting scholarship stored-value to help recipients pay for programs.
features.signal: table: scholarship (value_cents, expiration_policy); stored_value_account.scholarship_id
features.adoption_definition: Has >=1 scholarship programme configured. Redemption is a separate question and is not measured here. Measured 2026-09-07: 14 of 73 launched orgs (19 of 144 including unlaunched), 107 in total.
features.measure_question: How many scholarship programs has this organization set up, and how many scholarship awards (stored value accounts) have been granted?

features.name: Store Credit / Account Credit
features.description: Maintaining per-user account credit balances that can be applied to purchases.
features.signal: table: credit_account (balance); table: credit (amount); payment.payment_method_type = 'organizationCredit'
features.adoption_definition: Has >=1 credit_account with a nonzero balance, or >=1 credit transaction
features.measure_question: How many of this organization's users have a store-credit account with a nonzero balance, and how many credit accounts total?

features.name: Structured Refund Policies
features.description: Applying automated time-based refund rules to bookings.
features.signal: table: structured_refund_policy (rules JSONB, paused); section.structured_refund_policy_id; section.structured_refund_policy_paused
features.adoption_definition: Has >=1 structured_refund_policy defined, or >=1 section with structured_refund_policy_id set
features.measure_question: How many sections have a structured refund policy applied, and how many sections total?

features.name: Member / Group Pricing Tiers
features.description: Charging different prices to specific member groups (e.g. resident vs non-resident pricing).
features.signal: section.pricing_policy JSONB, shaped {"default":{"type":"fixed","cents":N,"groupCents":{<group uuid>: N}}}. THE section_price TABLE NO LONGER EXISTS.
features.adoption_definition: Has >=1 live section whose pricing_policy carries a non-empty groupCents object — i.e. a member/group price that differs from the default. The catalog previously named section_price.group_id; that table was dropped and the signal moved into this JSONB column. Measured: 20,982 sections, 68 orgs.
features.measure_question: How many sections have a group-specific (member) price tier, and how many sections have any custom price tier at all?

features.name: Tax Collection
features.description: Applying sales tax to products or court reservations.
features.signal: product.tax_bps > 0; court.tax_bps > 0
features.adoption_definition: Has >=1 product OR site with tax_bps above zero. Both count, because an org may tax merchandise, rentals, or both: 613 products across 19 orgs and 106 courts across 14. Measured 2026-09-07: 11 of 73 launched orgs (20 of 144 including unlaunched), 706 in total.
features.measure_question: How many products and courts have a nonzero tax rate configured, and how many products/courts are there in total?

features.name: Cash & Check Payments
features.description: Accepting in-person cash or check payments (beyond card/online).
features.signal: payment.payment_method_type, which uses HYPHENS: cash, check, card-online, card-present, organization-credit, free, scholarship, gift-card. Plus payment.cash_tendered_cents and payment.check_number.
features.adoption_definition: Has >=1 payment whose method is cash or check (168,912 and 4,329 platform-wide). The catalog previously wrote 'organizationCredit' in camelCase; the real value is 'organization-credit'. Measured 2026-09-07: 54 of 73 launched orgs, 163,530 cash or check payments in total.
features.measure_question: How many payments has this organization taken by cash or check, and how many payments total?

features.name: GL Accounting Configuration
features.description: Categorizing revenue into a chart of general-ledger accounts for finance reporting.
features.signal: table: gl_account (name, gl_code); table: gl_config (revenue-type to GL-account mappings); program.gl_account_id / court.gl_account_id / section.gl_account_id
features.adoption_definition: Has >=1 unarchived GL account. An archived account was configured once and is no longer in the chart, so it does not count. Measured 2026-09-07: 61 of 73 launched orgs (98 of 144 including unlaunched), 3,707 in total.
features.measure_question: How many general-ledger accounts has this organization set up in its chart of accounts?

features.name: SMS Messaging
features.description: Sending SMS messages to users (marketing and/or transactional).
features.signal: organization_sms_config.marketing_sms_number / transactional_sms_number (set); message.channel = 'sms'; message_delivery.segments/cost_cents
features.adoption_definition: Has an organization_sms_config with an SMS number set, or >=1 message with channel = 'sms'
features.measure_question: How many SMS messages has this organization sent (channel = 'sms'), and how many messages has it sent in total across all channels?

features.name: Email Messaging / Campaigns
features.description: Sending email messages/campaigns to users and tracking delivery.
features.signal: message.channel = 'email'; table: message_delivery (delivered_at, first_opened_at, open_count)
features.adoption_definition: Has >=1 email delivery on record (message_delivery.channel='email'). The single widest-adopted feature on the platform. Measured 2026-09-07: 65 of 73 launched orgs (78 of 144 including unlaunched), 740,896 in total.
features.measure_question: How many email messages has this organization sent, and how many total email deliveries (recipients) do those represent?

features.name: Custom Sending Email Domains
features.description: Sending email from the org's own verified custom domain rather than a default.
features.signal: organization_email_domain (domain, type, status). Status values: verified 17, not_started 8, failed 2, pending 2.
features.adoption_definition: Has >=1 VERIFIED sending domain. A domain added and never verified cannot send mail, so counting every row would report the feature as working when it is not.
features.measure_question: How many custom email domains has this organization set up, and how many of them are verified (status = 'verified')?

features.name: Notification Subscription Types
features.description: Defining custom notification subscription categories users can opt in/out of.
features.signal: table: subscription (name, opt_in_by_default); notification_preference.subscription_id
features.adoption_definition: Has >=1 notification subscription type configured. Note this table is marketing opt-ins (name, opt_in_by_default) and holds no renewal history. Measured 2026-09-07: 22 of 73 launched orgs (25 of 144 including unlaunched), 61 in total.
features.measure_question: How many notification subscription types has this organization created?

features.name: Audience Segments
features.description: Building dynamic user segments for targeted messaging and eligibility.
features.signal: table: segment (configuration JSONB, archived_at)
features.adoption_definition: Has >=1 unarchived audience segment. Archived segments are excluded — a retired segment is not the feature in use. Measured 2026-09-07: 46 of 73 launched orgs (58 of 144 including unlaunched), 283 in total.
features.measure_question: How many audience segments has this organization created?

features.name: Competitions / Leagues
features.description: Running leagues, tournaments, or round-robins with teams and matches.
features.signal: table: competition (type league/tournament); table: competition_section; table: competition_event; table: competition_team
features.adoption_definition: Has >=1 non-canceled competition. Canceled ones are excluded because a league that never ran is not the feature in use. Measured 2026-09-07: 18 of 73 launched orgs (24 of 144 including unlaunched), 172 in total.
features.measure_question: How many competitions (leagues/tournaments) has this organization created, and how many teams exist across them?

features.name: Public Storefront Products
features.description: Publishing products for sale in the public online storefront.
features.signal: product.publish_to_public (the opt-in) and product.display_in_store (effectively a default).
features.adoption_definition: Has >=1 product with publish_to_public = true (581 products, 74 orgs). NOT display_in_store, which is true on 4,685 of 5,860 products across 100 orgs and therefore cannot discriminate.
features.measure_question: How many products are published to the public storefront, and how many products does the organization have in total?

features.name: POS Desk Locations
features.description: Processing in-person point-of-sale transactions at physical desk/till locations.
features.signal: table: desk_location (name, enforce_access_control); transaction_event.desk_location_id; table: product_desk_location
features.adoption_definition: Has >=1 desk location, i.e. a physical point of sale. Desk locations are what the finance reports split cash-out and item-log figures by. Measured 2026-09-07: 41 of 73 launched orgs (56 of 144 including unlaunched), 396 in total.
features.measure_question: How many POS desk locations has this organization set up, and how many transactions were processed at a desk?

features.name: Cash Reconciliation Reports
features.description: Reconciling cash drawers with over/short reporting and deposit slips.
features.signal: table: cash_summary_report (total_cash_amount, expected_amount, short_over_amount, deposit_slip)
features.adoption_definition: Has >=1 cash-out report on record (cash_summary_report, with its expected/actual/short-over figures). Only meaningful for orgs taking cash at a desk. Measured 2026-09-07: 30 of 73 launched orgs (36 of 144 including unlaunched), 8,619 in total.
features.measure_question: How many cash reconciliation reports has this organization created?

features.name: Custom Staff Roles & Permissions
features.description: Defining custom staff roles with granular can_* permissions and assigning them to users.
features.signal: organization_role (29 can_* permission flags), organization_user_role, organization_user.
features.adoption_definition: Roles the org NAMED ITSELF — anything other than 'Full Access' and 'Limited Access'. ROLES ARE PLATFORM-SEEDED: 'Full Access' exists at 156 orgs and 'Limited Access' at 78, median 2 roles per org across 165, so counting rows measures the seed rather than adoption. Measured 2026-09-07: 45 of 73 launched orgs have at least one self-named role, 180 such roles in total.
features.measure_question: How many custom staff roles has this organization created, and how many staff users have a role assigned?

features.name: Alternate IDs / External System Integration
features.description: Storing external-system identifiers (e.g. IMLeagues) against users for cross-system integration.
features.signal: table: user_alternate_identity (source, source_id, alternate_id)
features.adoption_definition: Has >=1 alternate ID mapped to a user — the hook for an external system's own member number. Every row on the platform has source 'org'. Measured 2026-09-07: 23 of 73 launched orgs (25 of 144 including unlaunched), 27,509 in total.
features.measure_question: How many users have an alternate identity from an external system, and from how many distinct sources?

features.name: CRM / Household Notes
features.description: Staff keeping CRM-style admin notes on households.
features.signal: table: household_note (message, household_id); organization_role.can_manage_crm
features.adoption_definition: Has >=1 note recorded against a household. Gated in the product by organization_role.can_manage_crm. Measured 2026-09-07: 55 of 73 launched orgs (69 of 144 including unlaunched), 5,850 in total.
features.measure_question: How many household notes has this organization's staff created, and how many households are associated with the organization?

features.name: Events & Ticketing
features.description: Standalone ticketed events — concerts, camps-out, festivals — configured outside the program/section model.
features.signal: event rows (event.deleted_at IS NULL) per organization; event.is_ticketed marks the ones selling tickets, ticket_tier holds the price bands. NOTE event_session is EMPTY platform-wide (0 rows) — do not measure through it.
features.adoption_definition: Has >=1 live event (event.deleted_at IS NULL). Archived events count: adoption is whether the org has configured the feature, and an org that ran events last season still adopted it. event.canceled_at is non-null nowhere on the platform.
features.measure_question: How many events has this organization configured, and how many of them are ticketed?

features.name: Event Ticket Sales
features.description: Tickets actually sold for an event, as distinct from tickets sitting unpaid in a cart.
features.signal: event_ticket where status='confirmed' AND canceled_at IS NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL, joined to event/ticket_tier for the event and price.
features.adoption_definition: Has >=1 confirmed, non-canceled ticket. Counting every event_ticket row instead overstates by ~30% platform-wide, because status='pending' means unpaid in a cart — 5,095 of 17,112 rows, 1,082 of them at one org. A pending ticket is not a sale.
features.measure_question: How many tickets has this organization actually sold, and how many are still pending payment?

features.name: Seb (AI Assistant)
features.description: Staff asking Seb questions in the admin — the conversational assistant, not the scheduled routines.
features.signal: ai_chat_turn where status='succeeded' and the agent is a human-facing one. STATUS IS 'succeeded', NOT 'completed' — the obvious guess matches 0 of 5,337 rows. Threads live in ai_chat_thread; per-turn token and cost_usd are on the turn.
features.adoption_definition: Has >=1 succeeded turn a person initiated. The agents 'thread-titler', 'bulk-summarizer' and 'routine-draft-summarizer' are the SYSTEM titling threads and summarizing, not usage — 1,077 of 5,337 turns platform-wide, and at one org they outnumber the real ones 59 to 101. Turns under agent 'routine' are a scheduled routine running, counted separately.
features.measure_question: How many questions have this organization's staff asked Seb, and how many distinct people asked them?

features.name: Seb Routines (Scheduled AI)
features.description: Recurring jobs an org has set up for Seb to run on a schedule — a report every Monday, a weekly check on something.
features.signal: ai_chat_routine rows per organization (all rows). Runs are ai_chat_routine_run, and their turns appear in ai_chat_turn under agent='routine'.
features.adoption_definition: Has >=1 routine configured — the same shape as discount_codes and scholarships, where having set the thing up is the adoption signal. Runs are deliberately a different number: a routine configured and never fired is still adoption of the feature, and a busy routine is usage of it.
features.measure_question: How many scheduled Seb routines has this organization set up, and how often do they run?

notes: 56 of 57 catalog features measured, re-baked 2026-09-07 from the production read replica via scripts/refresh/fleet-query.sql. Metric definitions and their traps are documented in that file. Sandbox organizations are excluded; unlaunched organizations are included and flagged. 73 of 144 organizations are live on rec.us.
